note: The text uses the prime-gap bound Delta (Ramare's tables, RH verification) to find a prime p with n-p in the binary-Goldbach-verified range for n-4 < e^68. [L] gets the same prime p in the same place from its Proth-prime ladder (`Ladder.ladder_prime`), but only up to 1e27.

· -- a prime `p ∈ [n − 4·10¹⁸, n − 4]` from rung `i` of the ladder
    push Not at hsmall
    have hi1 : 1 ≤ (n - 5) / 3927138875067072512 := by omega
    have hi2 : (n - 5) / 3927138875067072512 ≤ 254638308 := by omega
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hp1, hp2⟩ := Ladder.ladder_prime hi1 hi2
    have hpb : p ≤ n - 4 := by omega
    have hpa : n - 4 * 10 ^ 18 ≤ p := by omega

proof_context.conclusion: For odd 4e18+3 < n <= 1e27, rung (n-5)/(111616*2^45) of the prime ladder gives a prime p with n - 4e18 <= p <= n - 4.
